title: 第十七章 何为道意第十八章 石头化水
content_zh:
将东方博送走了之后，姜云好奇的拿起了储物戒指，灵气涌入其中，眼前竟然真的出现了一个一米方圆的朦胧空间，里面摆放着两本书册。
“储物戒指，属于法器中的空间法器，是所有修士都几乎必备的东西，而法器又有品阶高低之分，品阶越高，质量越高，像这个戒指，连一品都算不上，故而空间不大。”
姜云一边回忆着东方博告诉自己的关于法器的知识，一边从这戒指之中取出了两本书册，刚准备翻开的时候，忽然肚内传来了“咕噜”一声。
这让他不禁面露苦笑，虽然成为修士，有了灵气，能够减缓饥饿的时间，但是自己已经两天两夜没有进食，再加上连续打通三条经脉，排出了那么多体内的杂质，现在肚子终于提出了抗议。
无奈之下，姜云只能将书册先暂时放到了一旁，转而取过玉瓶，从内倒出了一颗辟谷丹。
对于丹药，姜云非但不陌生，而且十六年里，在爷爷的调教之下，都已经不知道炼制出了多少颗丹药。
不过他从来没有炼制过这种可以充当食物的辟谷丹，毕竟莽山之中根本不缺食物，各种植物动物都可以用来食用，所以他炼制的丹药大都是用来治疗伤势和解毒的。
多年炼丹的经历，也让姜云对于各种丹药有着极大的兴趣，而之前吞服的道体丹和引气丹，因为当时形势和情绪影响，他也没有时间去注意，所以现在举着这颗辟谷丹，他并没有立刻服用，而是仔细的打量了起来。
他想要看看，修士服用的丹药和自己在莽山炼制的丹药有什么不同。
辟谷丹只有樱桃大小，颜色淡黄，表面略微有些颗粒状的凸起，放在鼻端，隐隐可以闻到一丝香味。
姜云吸了吸鼻子，自言自语的道：“以稻米为主材，添加了十日果和青柳汁炼制而成，不知道炼丹之人是如何炼制的，但是火候手法都是不行，不然丹药表面也不会这么粗糙了，自然丹效也不会太好！”
虽然姜云说的轻松，但如果他的这番话被其他修士，尤其是药师听见，绝对会无比的震惊。
要知道炼丹除了需要材料之外，最重要的还需要有丹方，也就是炼制某种丹药所需具体的材料配比等方法。
丹方对于药师来说，绝对是视若珍宝的东西，毕竟每一张丹方都是经历了无数次的失败之后才总结出来的，轻易都不可能示人。
然而姜云仅仅凭借着辟谷丹的气味，就判断出了其内所包含的材料，虽然并没有推断出具体的丹方，但也是极为罕见了。
甚至姜云有着把握，如果材料足够的话，给他几次试验的机会，他应该就能炼制出辟谷丹，而且丹效也肯定比他手中的这枚要好的多！
不过现在姜云自然不可能去炼制辟谷丹，所以在研究了一番之后，便将辟谷丹往自己的口中放去。
然而，异变陡生！
就看到他胸口所挂着的那块三角形的黑色石头之上，陡然亮起了一道幽光，紧接着“啪”的一声，那正准备被他送入口中的辟谷丹便直接炸了开来。
这似曾相识的一幕，自然让姜云想到了先前那面炸开的问道镜，而此刻他也终于肯定，当时自己并没有花眼。

甚至这一次，他更加清楚的看到，在辟谷丹炸开的时候，其内有着一缕芝麻大小的毫光，被骤然吸入了黑色石头之中。
随着毫光的消失，黑色石头之上瞬间就恢复了平静，一切都像没有发生过一样，除了姜云手指之间残存的一些辟谷丹的粉末。
“这是怎么回事？”姜云愣在了那里，一头雾水，唯一能够确定的，就是黑色石头从辟谷丹中吸走了什么东西。
黑色石头，是姜云离开姜村所带走的唯一一样东西，也是临行前姜月柔塞给他，并且一再叮嘱的“宝贝”。
content_en:
After sending Dongfang Bo away, Jiang Yun curiously picked up the storage ring, and spiritual energy poured into it. A hazy space with a radius of one meter actually appeared in front of him, with two books placed in it.
"A storage ring is a space magic weapon among magic weapons. It is an almost necessary item for all monks. Magic weapons are divided into high and low grades. The higher the grade, the higher the quality. A ring like this is not even a first-grade magic weapon, so there is not much space."
While recalling the knowledge Dongfang Bo told him about magical weapons, Jiang Yun took out two books from the ring. Just when he was about to open them, he suddenly heard a "Gulu" sound in his stomach.
This made him smile bitterly. Although he had become a monk and had spiritual energy that could slow down his hunger, he had not eaten for two days and two nights. In addition, he had opened three meridians in succession and discharged so many impurities from his body. Now his stomach finally protested.
In desperation, Jiang Yun could only put the book aside temporarily, then took the jade bottle and poured out a Bigu Pill from it.
Not only was Jiang Yun no stranger to elixirs, but he had refined countless elixirs under his grandfather's guidance in the past sixteen years.
However, he has never refined this kind of Bigu Pill that can be used as food. After all, there is no shortage of food in Mangshan. All kinds of plants and animals can be eaten, so most of the pills he refined are used to treat injuries and detoxify.
Years of experience in elixir refining also made Jiang Yun very interested in various elixirs. As for the Dao Body Pill and Qi Enlightenment Pill that he had swallowed before, he did not have time to pay attention to them due to the situation and emotions at the time. So now he held up the Bigu Pill and did not take it immediately, but looked at it carefully.
He wanted to see the difference between the elixir the monks took and the elixir he refined in Mangshan Mountain.
Bigu Dan is only the size of a cherry, light yellow in color, with slightly granular ridges on the surface. If you put it on the tip of your nose, you can faintly smell a hint of fragrance.
Jiang Yun sniffed and muttered to himself: "It is made from rice as the main material, with the addition of toka fruit and green willow juice. I don't know how the alchemist made it, but the heat method is not good, otherwise the surface of the elixir would not be so rough, and the natural elixir effect would not be very good!"
Although Jiang Yun said it lightly, if his words were heard by other monks, especially the pharmacist, they would definitely be extremely shocked.
You must know that in addition to the materials needed to make an elixir, the most important thing is the elixir recipe, which is the specific ratio of materials required to refine a certain elixir.
For pharmacists, elixir prescriptions are definitely something that is regarded as a treasure. After all, each elixir prescription is summed up after countless failures, and it is impossible to show it to others easily.
However, Jiang Yun was able to determine the materials contained in the Bigu Pill just by relying on its smell. Although he did not deduce the specific recipe for the pill, it was extremely rare.
Jiang Yun is even sure that if he has enough materials and is given a few opportunities to experiment, he should be able to refine the Bigu Pill, and the effect of the pill will definitely be much better than the one in his hand!
However, it was naturally impossible for Jiang Yun to refine the Bigu Pill now, so after some research, he put the Bigu Pill into his mouth.
However, a sudden change occurred!
He saw a faint light suddenly light up on the triangular black stone hanging on his chest, and then with a "pop" sound, the Bigu Pill that was about to be put into his mouth exploded.
This familiar scene naturally reminded Jiang Yun of the exploding interrogation mirror before, and at this moment he was finally sure that he was not dazzled at that time.
Even this time, he saw more clearly that when the Bigu Pill exploded, there was a ray of light the size of a sesame seed inside, which was suddenly sucked into the black stone.
As the light disappeared, on the black stoneCalmness returned in an instant, and everything was as if it had never happened, except for some Bigu Dan powder remaining between Jiang Yun's fingers.
"What's going on?" Jiang Yun froze there, confused. The only thing he could be sure of was that the black stone sucked something from the Bigu Pill.
The black stone was the only thing Jiang Yun took with him when he left Jiangcun. It was also the "treasure" Jiang Yuerou gave him and warned him repeatedly before leaving.
